text: WIZARDSCREEN TAKES `status` AND `actions`, AND ITS TITLE IS THE WIZARD RUNG. A record's badge and its whole-record actions now sit on the header's trailing edge, status first — where RecordScreen and DecisionScreen already put them — instead of riding in `notices` below the title. The title uses PageHeader size="compact", which the one-scale-per-kind rule already assigns to wizards; the two PM-AJAY Adarsh Gram forms on this template get the smaller title too. E-Anudaan's payment screens drop the page-type label above the title ("Payment Advice", "Authorise Payment Advice", "Payment Status"): the breadcrumb already names the page, and no other portal header carries one.
